setting.help:
How prepaid costs (periodiserade kostnader) are booked in this company. Model A (A_visma_cost_entry): the bill is booked normally on the expense/income account (e.g. 5010); when it is posted, the module parks the net amount on the interim / periodiseringskonto so the cost account's net effect is zero at booking, then the daily cron releases it month by month.
Model B (B_fortnox_interim_entry): the bill is booked directly on the interim / periodiseringskonto (e.g. 1710) - already parked; the daily cron releases it month by month.
VAT is NEVER deferred in either model: input VAT is booked directly and normally at posting. Only the net cost is parked and later released.
